{{Quote|A locally produced beer, but I saw a bottle of Abraxin Brandy inside, if that's more to your liking.''"<br />"''Thank you, but neither at the moment. Perhaps after working hours.|[[Lo Bukk]] and [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] talk about [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages|<ref name="DarthP" />}}
A '''beer''' locally-produced at a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Unidentified Barabel settlement|settlement]] on the southern continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]] was sold at an [[Unidentified eatery|eatery]] in the town<ref name="DarthP" /> between [[67 BBY/Legends|67]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Part One of the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], including the mention of the [[beer]], is established to have occurred between [[67 BBY/Legends|67]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].</ref> In addition to the beer, the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] sold [[Abraxin Brandy]].<ref name="DarthP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The beer was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DarthP" />
